title: Kubernetes Cluster

panels.title: Nodes asleep (cordoned)
panels.description: WOL workers are cordoned while powered off; NotReady there is expected.

panels.title: Pods unhealthy

targets.expr: (count((sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Failed|Unknown"}) > 0) unless on (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info and on (node) (kube_node_spec_unschedulable == 1)))) or vector(0)

panels.description: Pending/Failed/Unknown, excluding DaemonSet pods parked on sleeping WOL nodes.

panels.title: Workloads degraded
panels.description: Deployments/StatefulSets below desired replicas.

panels.title: Flux not ready
panels.description: Flux Kustomizations / GitRepositories whose Ready condition is not True (kube-state-metrics custom resource state).

panels.title: Cluster CPU used
panels.description: Awake nodes only (sleeping nodes report nothing).

panels.title: CPU requested
panels.description: Requests vs allocatable on awake nodes. Over ~90% = new pods won't schedule.

panels.title: Memory limits (overcommit)
panels.description: Sum of memory limits vs allocatable. Above 100% the node can OOM if everything peaks.

panels.title: Nodes

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - max by (node) (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="kubernetes-node-exporter", mountpoint="/var"}) / max by (node) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="kubernetes-node-exporter", mountpoint="/var"}))

panels.description: Same numbers as `kubectl top nodes` (both come from kubelet/cAdvisor), plus requests and Talos /var (EPHEMERAL: local-path PVCs, images, logs).

panels.title: CPU by node
panels.description: Cores in use.

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - max by (node, mountpoint) (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="kubernetes-node-exporter", fstype!~"tmpfs|squashfs|overlay"}) / max by (node, mountpoint) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="kubernetes-node-exporter", fstype!~"tmpfs|squashfs|overlay"}))

panels.title: Pressure (PSI) — time stalled
panels.description: Fraction of time tasks waited for CPU/memory/IO. Sustained >0.2 = node is saturated.

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: RPi4 reports via thermal_zone; x86 via hwmon. VMs usually report neither.

panels.title: Pods
panels.description: `kubectl top pods -A` plus requests/limits/restarts/node. Click a pod to drill down.

panels.title: Memory vs limit (top 10 containers)

targets.expr: topk(10, max by (namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", container!=""}) / on (namespace, pod, container) max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory"}))

panels.description: Approaching 100% = next OOMKill.

panels.title: CPU throttling (top 10)

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace", container!=""}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace", container!=""}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.description: Share of CFS periods throttled by the CPU limit. High = limit too low.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod!="", interface="eth0"}[$__rate_interval]))) * 8
topk(10, sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_network_transmit_bytes_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod!="", interface="eth0"}[$__rate_interval]))) * 8

panels.title: Unhealthy pods

targets.expr: (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace=~"$namespace", phase=~"Pending|Failed|Unknown"} == 1) unless on (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info and on (node) (kube_node_spec_unschedulable == 1))

panels.description: Excludes DaemonSet pods on sleeping WOL nodes.

panels.title: Containers waiting
panels.description: CrashLoopBackOff, ImagePullBackOff, CreateContainerConfigError ...

panels.title: Last termination reason
panels.description: Why each restarted container last died (OOMKilled, Error, ...).

panels.title: PersistentVolumeClaims

targets.expr: 100 * max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace"}) / max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace"})

panels.description: Used/Used% only exist for volumes kubelet can measure (NFS here). local-path PVCs are plain directories on the node's /var — watch /var used % in the Nodes table.

panels.title: etcd request latency (avg)

targets.expr: topk(8, sum by (operation, type) (rate(etcd_request_duration_seconds_sum[5m])) / sum by (operation, type) (rate(etcd_request_duration_seconds_count[5m])))

panels.description: As seen by the API server. Peladn's single etcd; sustained >100 ms = disk trouble.

panels.title: Scrape targets
panels.description: kubelet/cadvisor count sleeping WOL nodes as down — expected.

targets.expr: max by (customresource_kind, exported_namespace, name, ready, suspended, revision) (gotk_resource_info)

panels.title: Warning events
panels.description: Kubernetes events (Alloy loki.source.kubernetes_events). The API only keeps them ~1h; Loki keeps 30 days.

description: kubectl top + object state + control plane + events
